about: A Python library that saves web responses so repeat requests are answered from a local cache.

prs.title: Cached pages keep their accented letters
prs.broken: With one cache setting on, pages that did not name their text encoding were saved wrongly, so accented letters came back garbled. Pages in other encodings came back changed too.
prs.changed: Text is now saved as text only when it can be turned back into the exact original bytes. Anything else is kept as raw bytes.
prs.matters: A page read from the cache matches the page the server sent.
